proposals.title: Continue #162 i18n on field offline / GPS / related chrome
proposals.summary: After R9 collect chrome (#410), field-runtime.tsx still hard-codes English on Download for offline / Refresh offline cache, Show my location / Acquiring / permission denied / unavailable, Enable location to use GPS, Save feature / Save changes, Not set, Layer visibility aria-label, related-record editability and waiting-to-sync hints, and edits-waiting-to-sync titles. Extract into fieldRuntime / fieldGps / fieldOffline catalogs with t() calls. No Weblate, no RTL.
proposals.rationale: Only finishable open-issue slice left after collect i18n. Field collectors are the #162 audience (EU / LatAm demos); offline and GPS chrome is what they see first when leaving signal.
proposals.risk: Keep offlineMessage progress codes as-is. Reuse existing fieldRuntime / fieldGps / fieldOffline keys where possible; machine-translate non-en with the Phase 1.1 pattern. Scope to user-visible offline/GPS/related/save strings, not the whole 6k-line runtime.
proposals.ethosFit: Language follow-through on free field chrome. No Contour brand kit.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Extract remaining field offline Download/Refresh, GPS location, Save feature/changes, related-record, and edits-waiting strings into en/es/fr/de/pt-BR catalogs with t() calls; What's new optional (i18n-only can skip).

proposals.title: Honest data-collection item help (offline, sync, QR)
proposals.summary: item-types.md describes Data collection as a field deployment with offline area and QR share, but there is no help/items/data-collection.md. Collectors and authors only learn Download for offline, delta refresh, sync conflicts, and checkOnly dry-run from data-layer.md asides. Add a focused item help page: what a deployment is (map + editable layers + forms), Download / Refresh offline, sync queue + conflict review pointer, QR / link share, and an honest Not Field Maps / Not Survey123 line.
proposals.rationale: Core pillar with no dedicated help page after R9 honesty passes. Demo authors following item-types hit a dead end; offline reliability docs belong next to the surface that ships it.
proposals.risk: Do not invent offline tile budgets or Android-only flows beyond what the PWA ships. Cross-link data-layer syncConflicts / forms; CHANGELOG docs note; What's new optional.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest about free field capture without Field Maps cosplay. Guided UX docs before raw API.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add help/items/data-collection.md (offline download/refresh, sync, QR, honest limits); link from item-types + form/map help; CHANGELOG docs note.

proposals.title: Guided Nearest neighbor shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: nearestNeighborGenerator is no-param (adds nearest_distance_m via geography self-join). Analyze has no Nearest neighbor for this layer control; help/analysis/nearest-neighbor.md already documents the builder path. Mirror AnalyzeCentroidGuide: POST a single-step nearest-neighbor derived_layer; say O(N²) and single-row NULL in UI.
proposals.rationale: Cheapest remaining Analyze honesty win after Calculate geometry. No-param like centroid/bbox/vertices; help already honest from R9.
proposals.risk: Performance on large layers. Surface O(N²) honesty and featureLimit; do not invent KNN index requirements or a second-layer picker. Reuse Centroid worker path and i18n pattern.
proposals.ethosFit: Free proximity on your PostGIS. Honest about same-layer distance cost.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add analyze-nearest-neighbor-guide POSTing single-step nearest-neighbor derived_layer; link nearest-neighbor.md; What's new + CHANGELOG + locale catalogs.

proposals.title: Guided Fishnet shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: fishnetGenerator takes cellSize + unit + output polygons|lines (Buffer-shaped). Analyze has no Fishnet for this layer control; help/analysis/fishnet.md already matches ST_SquareGrid honesty. Mirror AnalyzeDensifyGuide / Buffer: short form, POST single-step fishnet derived_layer; gate to polygon geometryType; surface cell-count / MAX_CELLS honesty.
proposals.rationale: Next Buffer-shaped Analyze shortcut after Calculate geometry. Square-grid workflows are a common free substitute for ArcGIS Create Fishnet seats.
proposals.risk: Tiny cellSize on large polygons can explode rows. Reuse generator enrich max-cells check; say polygon-only and attributes dropped; do not invent hex cells or a separate extent picker.
proposals.ethosFit: Free square grid on your PostGIS. Prefer honest cell caps over fake hex / AOI chrome.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add analyze-fishnet-guide (cell size, unit, polygons|lines) for polygon layers; link fishnet.md; What's new + CHANGELOG + locale catalogs.

proposals.title: Guided Top N shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: topNGenerator takes numeric field + n + asc|desc (Buffer-shaped with a field picker from the layer schema). Analyze has no Top N for this layer control; help/analysis/top-n.md already documents NULLs-last and MAX_N. Mirror Calculate-geometry form shape: field select, N, direction; POST single-step top-n derived_layer.
proposals.rationale: Attribute sampling is the next low-risk Analyze gap after no-param / geometry Buffer-shaped tools. Single-layer field picker only — not a multi-input overlay UX.
proposals.risk: Non-numeric fields must be filtered out of the picker (generator validates type number). Cap N in the form to MAX_N; do not invent multi-field sort. Reuse existing Analyze i18n pattern.
proposals.ethosFit: Free Top N on your PostGIS. Guided field pick over raw SQL ORDER BY seats.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add analyze-top-n-guide (numeric field, N, asc|desc); link top-n.md; What's new + CHANGELOG + locale catalogs.

proposals.title: Honest recipe OSM overlay truncated flag
proposals.summary: recipe-runner hardcodes truncated: false on osm-features-overlay / relational / reverse-geocode outputs with a wave-2 comment, while GET /api/osm/query already computes truncated from featureCount vs returned rows. Wire the real truncated bit from OsmService results (or drop the field from the public shape if unused) and scrub remaining wave-2 comments so clients do not trust a permanent false.
proposals.rationale: Same class of recipe honesty as AOI wave-2 (#396). Demo tools that hit Overpass caps silently claim completeness.
proposals.risk: Confirm client consumers of truncated before flipping true. Prefer plumbing the existing OsmService / maxFeatures signal over inventing a new cap UI. CHANGELOG docs note; skip What's new unless a user-visible banner lands.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest about Overpass caps on free self-hosted tools. No fake completeness.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Propagate truncated from OsmService/maxFeatures into recipe overlay outputs; remove wave-2 comments; CHANGELOG docs note + tool help if the flag is user-visible.

proposals.title: Guided Random sample shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: randomSampleGenerator takes mode percentage|count + value + stable seed (Buffer-shaped). Analyze has no Random sample for this layer control; help/analysis/random-sample.md already documents md5(global_id||seed) stability. Mirror Top N / Densify: short form, POST single-step random-sample derived_layer; expose seed with a reshuffle control that stays client-side.
proposals.rationale: Pairs with Top N for sampling honesty. Single-layer, no otherSource picker; help already shipped in R9.
proposals.risk: Do not use Postgres random() (non-stable). Keep seed persisted on the recipe; cap count to MAX_COUNT; percentage 0..100 validation in the form. Reuse Analyze i18n pattern.
proposals.ethosFit: Free stable sample on your PostGIS. Honest seed over shuffle cosplay.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add analyze-random-sample-guide (mode, value, seed); link random-sample.md; What's new + CHANGELOG + locale catalogs.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public POST /api/tools/:id/run
proposals.summary: ToolsController.run is @Public with only the global 300/min ThrottlerGuard. Anonymous callers can run public Overpass-backed tools (osm-features-overlay / relational) and burn egress. Add @Throttle({ default: { ttl: 60_000, limit: 30 } }) matching anonymous drawings writes; keep auth behaviour unchanged.
proposals.rationale: Standing Low follow-up from R8/R9 Security Sentinel notes. Small hardening, no product call, reduces anonymous Overpass abuse surface.
proposals.risk: Embedded public web apps that run tools in a tight loop may hit 30/min. Prefer 30 to match drawings; document in CHANGELOG Security. Add a regression test that the decorator is present if the suite already covers throttle metadata.
proposals.ethosFit: Self-hosted hardenings without waiting on pricing or Keycloak defaults.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 30/min on ToolsController.run; CHANGELOG Security note; skip What's new.
